newsitem.title: INDIA: India's JM Mutual starts refinery, petrochem fund.
newsitem.headline: India's JM Mutual starts refinery, petrochem fund.

text.p: India's private JM Mutual Fund said on Wednesday it had launched India's first mutual fund dedicated to invest in shares of oil, gas, refinery and petrochemical firms.
The fund styled JM Basic Fund will be open for repurchase at the net asset value (NAV) after three years from the date of allotment, JM Mutual Fund officials said.
"Large refineries are being built (in India)," JM Group chairman Nimesh Kampani told a news conference. "The sector has a big future," he said.
He said India's per capita consumption of petrochemicals was abysmally low compared to the world average, offering great scope for improvement in the years to come.
Kampani said the refinery and petrochemical business was highly cyclical and the "concentrated" investment in a handful of shares involved high risk as well as high rewards.
"It is good to get in at the lower end of the cycle."

Analysts said JM Mutual Fund was preparing in advance to reap the benefits of the proposed deregulation of India's oil and gas industry which promised to boost the profitability of the domestic refineries.
Other sector funds dedicated to pharmaceuticals, cement and banking sectors are on the anvil, Kampani said.
